item.title: Site Management
item.description:
For Designers & Managers

Roles: Installer (view), Designer (view/edit), Manager (full access)

Create and manage the site hierarchy for your organization.

Accessing Site Management

From the sidebar, tap Sites under the Setup section.

Creating a New Site

Roles: Manager only

  1. Tap Create new site in the toolbar
  2. Enter a name for the site
  3. Tap Create

Viewing Site Details

  1. Tap a site from the list
  2. View buildings within the site
  3. Navigate to floors and zones

item.title: Floor Plan Setup
item.description:
For Designers & Managers

Roles: Designer, Manager

Upload and configure floor plans for device installation.

Accessing Floor Configuration

  1. Navigate to Sites > Select a site > Select a building > Select a floor
  2. Tap to edit floor settings

Uploading a Floor Plan

  1. In the floor detail view, find the floor plan section
  2. Tap Upload floor plan
  3. Select an image from your photo library

item.title: Zone Management
item.description:
For Designers & Managers

Roles: Designer, Manager

Create zones within floors to logically organize device locations.

Understanding Zones

Zones are logical areas within a floor, such as:

  • Rooms or offices
  • Corridors
  • Common areas
  • Storage areas
  • Meeting rooms
  • Workspaces

Devices can be associated with zones for location tracking and analytics.

Creating Zones

  1. Navigate to a floor
  2. Tap Add Zone or the zone management option
  3. Draw the zone boundary on the floor plan
  4. Enter a name for the zone
  5. Save the zone

Zone Boundaries

  • Draw polygon boundaries by tapping corner points on the floor plan
  • Close the polygon to complete the zone
  • Zones can overlap if needed (e.g., a device might be in both “Building Wing A” and “Temperature Monitoring Zone”)

Drawing Zone Polygons

  1. Tap the first corner point of the zone
  2. Continue tapping to add corner points
  3. The app draws lines between points
  4. Tap the starting point to close the polygon
  5. Or tap “Complete” to auto-close

Editing Zone Boundaries

  1. Select an existing zone
  2. Tap Edit Boundary
  3. Drag corner points to adjust
  4. Add new points by tapping on edges
  5. Remove points by tapping and deleting
  6. Save changes

item.title: Account Settings
item.description:
For Designers & Managers

Manage your personal account settings, user management, and organization administration.

Note: Organization Management and Data Retention sections are for Sysadmin only.

Own Settings

Roles: All users

Manage your personal account settings.

Accessing Account Settings

From the sidebar, tap Own settings under the Account section.

Account Information

View your:

  • Organization role: Your permission level (Viewer, Installer, Designer, Manager, Sysadmin)
  • Organization: Your organization name
  • Email: Your login email address
  • Identifier: Your user UUID

Changing Password

  1. Tap Change password
  2. Enter your current password
  3. Enter your new password
  4. Confirm the new password
  5. Tap Save

item.title: Data Export
item.description:
For Designers & Managers

Roles: Manager only

Export bulk data including device inventory, measurements, and configuration for analysis or backup.

Accessing Data Export

From the sidebar, tap Export data in bulk under the Other section.

Export Options

Date Range

  1. Select Start date
  2. Select End date

Note: Export range is limited to 7 days by default (or 360 days with experimental features enabled) to prevent excessively large downloads.
